data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to embed and customize Jitsi Meet video conferencing and calling features.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Flutter plugin that wraps the native Jitsi Meet SDKs to embed full-featured video conferencing and calling. Allows users to join meetings, manage local audio and video, handle chat, and listen to conference events.
use_when: You need to embed Jitsi Meet video calls directly inside your Flutter mobile application.
You want built-in support for meeting features like chat, screen sharing, and participant management.
avoid_when: You need web platform support, as the README states web is not supported.
You want a custom UI built from scratch rather than the native Jitsi Meet application experience.
strengths: Delivers the same user experience as the native Jitsi Meet app.
Comprehensive event listener system for tracking participants, audio/video states, and chat messages.
Supports advanced configurations such as configOverrides and featureFlags.
weaknesses: Requires manual native configuration for both iOS (Podfile versions, permissions, screen sharing extension) and Android (minSdkVersion, Manifest changes, ProGuard).
data.setup_notes: Requires setting minimum iOS version to 15.1, configuring NSCameraUsageDescription and NSMicrophoneUsageDescription in Info.plist, setting Android minSdkVersion to at least 24, and modifying AndroidManifest.xml for label conflicts.
